title: Improper verification of cryptographic signature in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to…
description: A vulnerability in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) involves improper verification of cryptographic signatures, which could allow an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing attacks over a network. The flaw is identified as CVE-2026-88078 and has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3. No specific affected versions or patches are currently detailed.
